metadata.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 | Uniglo
metadata.description: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027, June 4–7. Find event details, registration and natural-diamond sourcing information.

announcement: JCK Las Vegas 2027 · June 4–7 · The Venetian Expo · Meet Uniglo Diamonds

hero.eyebrow: Trade show · June 4–7, 2027 · Las Vegas, Nevada
hero.title: Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027
hero.lead: JCK Las Vegas 2027 will take place from June 4–7, 2027, at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas, Nevada.
hero.para1: The business-to-business jewelry show brings together qualified retailers, buyers, designers, manufacturers, diamond suppliers and other professionals from across the international jewelry industry. Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to return as a natural-diamond supplier at JCK Las Vegas 2027.
hero.para2: Buyers will be able to meet the Uniglo Diamonds team, examine loose natural diamonds and discuss requirements for bridal, gifting, everyday jewelry and repeat manufacturing. Uniglo Diamonds' 2027 booth number and JCK's final show-floor opening hours will be added once officially confirmed.

eventDetails.note1: Although the main JCK show begins on Friday, June 4, selected areas and programs will open one day earlier. AGTA and GEMS, the Hong Kong Pavilion, the Lifestyle Pavilion and selected JCK Talks sessions are scheduled to open on Thursday, June 3.
eventDetails.note2: Luxury will run from June 2–7, with June 2 and 3 operating as invitation-only days for approved high-end jewelry retailers. Visitors should check their registration and badge permissions before planning which areas to attend.

whyAttend.title: Why Jewelry Buyers Attend JCK Las Vegas
whyAttend.para1: JCK Las Vegas is a major buying, sourcing and networking event for the jewelry trade. Retailers attend to discover new products, compare suppliers, write orders and prepare their assortments for upcoming retail seasons.
whyAttend.para2: The show covers multiple jewelry and business categories. Visitors can explore loose diamonds, colored gemstones, fine jewelry, bridal collections, watches, packaging, retail technology, security services, manufacturing tools and other professional solutions in one location.
whyAttend.para3: For diamond buyers, this offers a practical advantage. Instead of evaluating suppliers through photographs and digital inventories alone, they can inspect stones directly, ask detailed questions and compare options during the same trip.
whyAttend.para4: JCK also provides educational and networking opportunities. JCK Talks and other professional programs examine issues affecting the industry, including consumer behavior, marketing, technology, business management, security and changing product trends.
whyAttend.para5: These insights can help buyers evaluate not only which diamonds they want to source but why particular shapes, qualities and price positions may be relevant to their customers.

meet.title: Meet a Natural-Diamond Supplier at JCK Las Vegas 2027
meet.para1: Uniglo Diamonds' participation at JCK gives jewelry retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers and designers an opportunity to discuss natural-diamond requirements directly with an experienced supplier.
meet.para2: Every buyer has different priorities. One retailer may require documented center stones for bridal jewelry, while another may need matched diamonds for earrings or consistent stones for a repeat collection. A designer may be searching for a particular fancy shape, and a manufacturer may need diamonds that meet defined measurement and quality ranges.
meet.para3: At JCK Las Vegas 2027, Uniglo Diamonds plans to present a carefully selected range of natural diamonds across different shapes, carat weights, colors, clarities and measurements. Availability will depend on the inventory prepared for the exhibition.
meet.para4: Meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team allows buyers to examine these stones directly and discuss how each option may fit a particular design, customer or retail price point.
meet.imageAlt: Natural diamonds presented by Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas

sourcing.title: Natural-Diamond Sourcing for Retailers and Jewelry Buyers
sourcing.para1: Diamond sourcing should not be based on carat weight or a grading-report headline alone. Cut, color, clarity, proportions, fluorescence, symmetry, polish and overall visual appearance can all affect a diamond's suitability for a piece of jewelry. Two diamonds with similar grades can look different when viewed directly, particularly when their proportions or cutting characteristics vary.
sourcing.para2: The intended use of the diamond also matters. A center stone for an engagement ring may require a different balance of specifications from diamonds being matched for earrings, a tennis bracelet or an eternity band.
sourcing.discussLabel: At JCK, buyers can discuss questions such as:
discussItems: Which diamond specifications suit a particular retail price?
Which shapes are relevant to a specific bridal market?
What should be checked on a grading report?
How should diamonds be matched for earrings?
Which qualities are suitable for multi-stone jewelry?
Can similar quality be supplied for repeat requirements?
How do proportions affect the appearance of different shapes?
Which diamonds offer the right balance of appearance, quality and budget?
sourcing.outro: This approach helps buyers source diamonds according to their commercial purpose instead of treating every stone as an isolated purchase.

bridal.title: Natural Diamonds for Bridal Jewelry
bridal.para1: Bridal jewelry remains one of the most important commercial applications for polished diamonds. A retailer may require documented center stones across popular shapes, carat weights and quality combinations. A jewelry manufacturer may need center diamonds with matching side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs.
bridal.para2: Bespoke jewelers may instead require an individual natural diamond selected around a client's setting, budget and visual preferences.
bridal.para3: A commercially useful bridal inventory often needs a balance between familiar options and distinctive diamonds for customers seeking something more personal. Retailers should consider which shapes, carat weights, quality combinations and price positions are currently missing from their bridal inventories before meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team.

gifting.title: Natural Diamonds for Gifting and Everyday Jewelry
gifting.para1: Not every diamond purchase is connected to an engagement or wedding. Diamond earrings, pendants, necklaces, bracelets and rings also support birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, personal achievements, self-purchase and everyday luxury.
gifting.para2: Different applications create different sourcing requirements. Diamond earrings require careful matching, while tennis bracelets and necklaces require consistency across a much larger number of stones. A solitaire pendant may use one visually attractive diamond, while an eternity ring may require tightly calibrated stones that work together as a complete layout.
gifting.discussLabel: Uniglo Diamonds can discuss natural diamonds for:
gifting.outro: The objective is to select diamonds according to how they will be set, presented and sold rather than relying on one general quality standard for every product category.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewelry Manufacturing
matching.para1: Matching becomes essential when multiple diamonds will be used in the same piece of jewelry. Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone designs require consistency across relevant characteristics.
matching.para2: For manufacturers, accurate calibration can also improve setting efficiency and production repeatability. Diamonds that vary significantly in size or proportion may require adjustments during setting and can create an uneven finished appearance.
matching.discussLabel: At JCK, buyers can discuss requirements for:
matching.para3: These requirements should be explained at the beginning of the sourcing process so that the proposed selection reflects the final jewelry application.
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds

measurements.title: Diamond Measurements, Proportions and Visual Appearance
measurements.para1: Carat weight is an essential measurement, but it does not provide a complete picture of how a polished diamond will look. Two diamonds with the same carat weight may have different dimensions, proportions and face-up appearances. This is particularly relevant for fancy-shaped diamonds, where outline and length-to-width ratio can significantly influence the diamond's character.
measurements.para2: A manufacturer may require precise dimensions to fit an existing mounting. A retailer may prefer an Oval or Emerald diamond with a particular length-to-width ratio. A designer may need stones with proportions that support a specific visual direction.
measurements.considerLabel: Before meeting Uniglo Diamonds, buyers should consider whether they require:
considerItems: Existing mountings that must be accommodated
Visual qualities not fully represented by a grading report

certification.title: Certification and Grading-Report Requirements
certification.para1: Documentation requirements differ depending on the diamond's size, value, intended market and customer expectations. Some buyers require individual grading reports for center stones. Other applications may use commercial documentation appropriate to smaller or calibrated diamonds.
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Whether documentation must accompany each stone
Requirements for matched pairs or multi-stone layouts
certification.para2: Documentation should be discussed at the beginning of the sourcing process rather than after a diamond selection has already been prepared.

whatToDDiscuss.title: What Buyers Can Discuss With Uniglo Diamonds at JCK
whatToDDiscuss.para1: A productive trade-show meeting should go beyond viewing available stones. It should help both parties determine whether there is a suitable basis for working together.
whatToDDiscuss.discussLabel: Buyers meeting Uniglo Diamonds can discuss:
discussItems: Preferred diamond shapes and carat-weight ranges
whatToDDiscuss.note: Buyers with specific requirements should share them before the meeting whenever possible. This gives the Uniglo Diamonds team an opportunity to prepare relevant options and make better use of the available appointment time.

inPerson.title: Why Examine Natural Diamonds in Person?
inPerson.para1: Digital sourcing makes it easier to discover products, review inventory and begin conversations with suppliers. However, natural diamonds can still benefit from direct examination. A grading report provides important technical information, but it cannot communicate every aspect of how a diamond appears in different lighting.
inPerson.assessLabel: An in-person assessment can help buyers examine:
inPerson.para2: Examining diamonds at JCK allows these factors to be considered before a larger or longer-term sourcing decision is made.
inPerson.imageAlt: Natural-diamond sourcing meeting with Uniglo Diamonds at JCK

antwerp.title: Antwerp-Based Diamond Sourcing Expertise
antwerp.para1: Antwerp has played a central role in the international diamond trade for generations. Uniglo Diamonds' Antwerp background connects the company with one of the world's most established diamond-trading centers.
antwerp.para2: However, location alone does not create a successful supplier relationship. Buyers also require clear communication, correctly understood specifications, realistic delivery expectations and consistent follow-up. A supplier must understand not only which grades have been requested but also how the diamonds will be used and sold.
antwerp.para3: Uniglo Diamonds approaches sourcing by first understanding the buyer's intended product, market and customer. This allows the team to assess which shapes, measurements, quality combinations and supply arrangements may be most appropriate.
antwerp.para4: This approach can support a retailer sourcing individual center stones, a manufacturer preparing a repeat collection, a wholesaler serving several markets or a designer developing a specialized diamond-led range.

registration.title: JCK Las Vegas 2027 Registration and Badge Requirements
registration.para1: JCK Las Vegas is not open to the general public. Registration is intended for qualified professionals connected to the jewelry and watch industries.
registration.para2: Each edition requires a new registration. Attendees who previously visited JCK must register again for the 2027 event because badges from earlier editions do not remain valid.
registration.para3: Applicants may be required to provide documents demonstrating their company's relationship with the jewelry industry and evidence of their employment with that business. The company name and address on submitted documents should match the information used during registration.
registration.para4: Business cards are no longer accepted as sufficient qualification documents.
registration.para5: A current government-issued photo ID is required to collect a badge. Photocopies and photographs stored on a phone are not accepted. Each attendee may only collect and print the badge associated with their own identification.
registration.para6: Children under 14 are not permitted. Babies carried in approved carriers may be admitted with show-management approval, but strollers are not allowed on the show floor.
registration.para7: Visitors should complete registration and credential approval before arranging nonrefundable travel.

prepare.title: How to Prepare for JCK Las Vegas 2027
prepare.para: JCK is a substantial international exhibition. Buyers who attend without a plan may find it difficult to prioritize the suppliers, product categories and programs most relevant to their businesses. Before traveling, visitors should:
items: Confirm that registration has been approved
Check the final show-floor dates and hours
Download or examine the latest floor plan
Prepare shapes, measurements and quality ranges
Establish target prices and approximate quantities
Arrange important supplier meetings in advance
Review JCK Talks and networking opportunities
Check which areas open on June 3
prepare.note: Buyers should also allow enough time between appointments. The scale of The Venetian Expo and the number of exhibition areas can make moving between meetings take longer than expected.

partnerships.title: Building Supplier Relationships Beyond the Show
partnerships.para1: The value of JCK is not measured only by orders written during the exhibition. It also comes from the relationships and conversations that continue after the show closes.
partnerships.para2: For Uniglo Diamonds, returning to JCK is an opportunity to reconnect with established partners while meeting retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers and designers discovering the company for the first time.
partnerships.nextStepsLabel: After the exhibition, a buyer may wish to:
nextSteps: Prepare matched pairs or coordinated side stones
Schedule another viewing or sourcing discussion
partnerships.para3: Long-term sourcing relationships are built through consistent quality, transparent communication, reliable service and a clear understanding of the buyer's business objectives. These principles remain central to Uniglo Diamonds' approach.

lookingAhead.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027
lookingAhead.para1: From June 4–7, 2027, JCK will bring the international jewelry trade together at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas.
lookingAhead.para2: Uniglo Diamonds looks forward to presenting natural diamonds and meeting retailers, buyers, designers, manufacturers, wholesalers and other qualified industry professionals.
lookingAhead.para3: Whether you are sourcing an individual center stone, strengthening a bridal inventory, arranging matched diamonds or looking for a dependable long-term supplier, we invite you to meet the Uniglo Diamonds team at JCK Las Vegas 2027.
lookingAhead.note: The confirmed booth number, final show-floor hours and meeting information will be published on this page when available.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About JCK Las Vegas 2027

items.question: When is JCK Las Vegas 2027?
items.answer: The main JCK Las Vegas 2027 exhibition will take place from Friday, June 4 through Monday, June 7, 2027.

items.question: Where will JCK Las Vegas 2027 be held?
items.answer: JCK 2027 will be held at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas, Nevada.

items.question: What are the JCK Las Vegas 2027 show hours?
items.answer: The final 2027 show-floor hours have not yet been clearly confirmed by the organizer. This page will be updated when the official schedule is published.

items.question: Do parts of JCK open before June 4?
items.answer: Yes. AGTA and GEMS, the Hong Kong Pavilion, the Lifestyle Pavilion and selected JCK Talks sessions are scheduled to open on Thursday, June 3, 2027.

items.question: Who can attend JCK Las Vegas?
items.answer: JCK is intended for qualified jewelry and watch industry professionals, including retailers, buyers, designers, wholesalers, manufacturers, diamond and gemstone professionals, service providers and approved industry media.

items.question: Is JCK Las Vegas open to the public?
items.answer: No. JCK is a business-to-business trade show. Applications are reviewed, and attendees may need to provide business and employment documents demonstrating their connection to the jewelry industry.

items.question: Is registration required for JCK 2027?
items.answer: Yes. Every attendee must complete registration for the 2027 edition. A badge from a previous JCK event does not provide automatic entry.

items.question: What identification is required?
items.answer: A current government-issued photo ID is required to collect a badge. Photocopies and photographs of an ID are not accepted.

items.question: Can a business card be used as an industry credential?
items.answer: No. JCK states that business cards are no longer accepted as qualification documents.

items.question: Are children allowed at JCK?
items.answer: Children under 14 are not permitted. Babies in carriers may be admitted with show-management approval, but strollers are not allowed on the show floor.

items.question: What is the difference between JCK and Luxury?
items.answer: JCK is the main international jewelry trade exhibition running from June 4–7. Luxury runs from June 2–7, with June 2 and 3 operating as invitation-only days for approved high-end jewelry retailers.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' booth number at JCK 2027?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds' 2027 booth number has not yet been officially confirmed. It will be added to this page when the current exhibitor directory and floor plan are published.

items.question: What can buyers source from Uniglo Diamonds at JCK?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss loose natural diamonds across different shapes, carat weights, measurements, colors and clarities. Requirements may include individual center stones, matched pairs, calibrated diamonds, bridal sourcing and repeat supply.

items.question: Which natural-diamond shapes can buyers discuss?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss Round Brilliant, Oval, Emerald, Pear, Cushion, Princess, Radiant, Marquise, Heart and Asscher diamonds, subject to availability and the buyer's required specifications.

items.question: Can buyers discuss matched or calibrated diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss matched pairs, calibrated selections, coordinated side stones and layouts for multi-stone jewelry.

items.question: Can manufacturers discuss repeat-supply requirements?
items.answer: Yes. Manufacturers should provide their required shapes, measurements, quality ranges, quantities and production schedules when discussing repeat supply.

items.question: Should buyers arrange an appointment with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: An appointment is recommended for buyers with specific diamond grades, shapes, measurements, quantities or target prices. Booking information will be provided once Uniglo Diamonds' 2027 booth and meeting arrangements are confirmed.

finalCta.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at JCK Las Vegas 2027 to explore natural diamonds and Antwerp-based sourcing possibilities. Prepare your preferred shapes, measurements, quality ranges, documentation requirements and intended jewelry applications so the team can plan a more relevant discussion.
finalCta.primaryCta: Book a JCK Trade Meeting with Uniglo Diamonds
finalCta.note: Confirmed booth number and final show hours will be published when available. Registration must be completed in advance.
